title: Karakoram 2026: China and Pakistan's first joint army drill

scenes.title: Karakoram 2026: China and Pakistan's armies train together
scenes.say: For the first time, the armies of China and Pakistan have trained together. Here's what Karakoram 2026 means.

scenes.title: Nine days in Xinjiang
scenes.say: The exercise ran for nine days, from 14 to 22 October, in Korla, in China's Xinjiang region. China calls it their first joint army training.
scenes.speak: The exercise ran for nine days, from the fourteenth to the twenty-second of October, in Korla, in China's Xinjiang region. China calls it their first joint army training.

scenes.title: Drones at the centre
scenes.say: The official focus was high-altitude counterterrorism. Drones were at the centre, with moving-target drills, long-range sniping, live-force exercises and joint command.

scenes.title: From buying arms to training together
scenes.say: China and Pakistan have cooperated for decades, on arms, naval drills and counterterror exercises. Karakoram brings their regular armies together.

scenes.title: Pakistani troops trained on Chinese systems
scenes.say: Pakistani troops worked with Chinese equipment, from Type 191 rifles to Type 11 assault vehicles and Type 08 infantry fighting vehicles.
scenes.speak: Pakistani troops worked with Chinese equipment, from Type one-nine-one rifles to Type eleven assault vehicles and Type zero-eight infantry fighting vehicles.

scenes.text: Karakoram 2026 does not, by itself, prove preparations for a specific conflict.
scenes.say: For India, it means growing China–Pakistan military familiarity. But one drill does not prove preparation for any specific conflict.

scenes.title: The signals that matter
scenes.say: What to watch: whether the drills repeat, whether drone cooperation deepens, whether command procedures merge, and whether new arms deals follow.
